verdict.rationale: Event-driven automation rules are a fair question for a coding agent, so the axis applies, but the pack documents no Codex feature for defining rules that fire actions on events. Starting cloud work from GitHub, GitLab, Linear or Slack is a manual way to begin a task, not a user-defined trigger rule. Calling `codex exec` from pipelines depends on external CI to do the triggering, which is a user-side or host-platform workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
